constraints: If resFile is a valid resource file reference number, only that file's resource types are listed; if omitted, all currently open resource files are used.
resTypes may be predeclared as a String/Text array; otherwise the command creates it as a Text array.

overloadMerges.note: Draft tagged resTypes direction:in, but the arrow column marks it out (←) -- it is populated by the command, not read from.

params.name: resFile
params.description: Resource file reference number, or all open resource files, if omitted

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Populates resTypes with the distinct resource types present across the currently open resource files (or one file if resFile is given).
